headline_tag: uptrend intact, but a Binance hack has shaken the week

action.title: SCALE UP acquisition budget
action.detail: The model's budget posture is still to scale up acquisition: the long-run uptrend is intact, and this kind of phase has historically been when spending to win new and returning users paid back best, especially among active traders. This week calls for applying it carefully: a hack at Binance has shaken trust across the market, price is about 5% under its 50-day average and the mood is fearful, so add spend in small steps, lead with safety and trust messages rather than hard offers, and speed up only once price wins back about $81,931. This is a budget-timing guide for the business, not trading advice.

reasons: BTC ($78,028) is about 7% above its 200-day average ($73,125), which is still rising.
Up about 24% over 90 days; about 81% of those days closed above the long-term average.
But price has closed under its 50-day average ($81,931) for nine days, about 5% below it.
Binance reported an estimated $6.3 billion hack; Fear & Greed sits at 30 (fear).
watch: The long-run trend still points up, but the Binance hack has dented confidence and bets on further falls are unusually popular right now. If Binance reopens withdrawals smoothly and price closes back above $79,750 the week steadies, while a close below $74,694 would start a drop signal.
analysis: Bottom line: the long-run uptrend still holds, but this week has turned clearly weaker. Short term, the picture is soft and leaning down: Bitcoin has closed below its 50-day average for nine days, now about 5% under it and about 10% below its 30-day high, and the Fear & Greed reading has slipped to 30 (fear). News is pulling this down further, as Binance, the largest exchange, estimates about $6.3 billion was taken from its hot wallets and paused deposits and withdrawals, while saying about $3 billion is frozen and it will cover all losses (PANews). A close above $79,750 (the top of a typical week's swing) would steady the week, a close below $76,250 (the bottom of that swing) turns it further down, and in between it stays choppy within a normal weekly swing of about $3,350, with $73,125 (the 200-day average) as the bigger floor; hold big pushes until the Binance story settles.

Over the next month, the read is mixed. The three-month numbers still look healthy, with price about 24% above three months ago and about four in five of the last 90 days closing above the long-term average, but the last few weeks point the other way, with price down about 7% over 30 days. News is nudging this down a little, as European officials reportedly expect a rate rise on 17 December and Nasdaq is pushing listed companies against trading their shares on blockchain venues (PANews). Price must win back $81,931 (the 50-day average) before the month leans up again, with room to climb above $86,603 (the 90-day high); until then, plan campaigns but keep launch dates flexible.

Over three to six months, the trend still leans up, and it is the most confident of the three. Price is about 7% above its 200-day average, which is still rising slowly, and about 38% below its record, which reads as a recovery still in progress rather than a late-stage run; Strategy, the largest company holder, reported owning 848,517 Bitcoin after buying about $14.3 billion worth this year (PANews). The recovery stays intact while price holds above $73,125 (the 200-day average), with $67,266 (the 200-week average) as the next floor and $124,753 (the all-time high) as the far marker. A close under the 200-day average would weaken this read and argue for slowing spend on new users.

items.theme: Binance hack spills into DeFi tokens
items.why: Reports say the Binance attacker sold large amounts of tokens including UNI, ENA, PEPE, LINK, AAVE, ONDO and WLD for ETH, and later began selling STRK. Aave froze new deposits and borrowing on its main markets as a precaution after a linked address borrowed from it, though it says its contracts are unaffected.
items.marketing_angle: A teaching moment on how one exchange incident can ripple across many tokens; keep it factual and calm.
